items.known: CKV_AWS_39 Ensure Amazon EKS public endpoint disabled (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS cluster API server endpoint public access not explicitly disabled
items.remediation: Add endpoint_public_access = false inside the vpc_config block. If public access is required, restrict it with public_access_cidrs to known IP ranges instead of the default 0.0.0.0/0

items.known: CKV_AWS_37 Ensure Amazon EKS control plane logging is enabled for all log types (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS control plane logging not enabled
items.remediation: Add enabled_cluster_log_types = ["api", "audit", "authenticator", "controllerManager", "scheduler"] to the aws_eks_cluster resource

items.known: CKV_AWS_58 Ensure EKS Cluster has Secrets Encryption Enabled (resource aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster)
items.issue: EKS secrets not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key
items.remediation: Add an encryption_config block to the aws_eks_cluster resource specifying resources = ["secrets"] and a provider key_arn pointing to a customer-managed AWS KMS key

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet1)
items.issue: Subnet auto-assigns public IP addresses (map_public_ip_on_launch = true)
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Worker nodes should reside in private subnets and access the internet through a NAT Gateway if outbound connectivity is required

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.eks_subnet2)
items.issue: Subnet auto-assigns public IP addresses (map_public_ip_on_launch = true)
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Worker nodes should reside in private subnets and access the internet through a NAT Gateway if outbound connectivity is required

items.known: CKV2_AWS_11 Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs (resource aws_vpc.eks_vpc)
items.remediation: Add an aws_flow_log resource referencing this VPC (vpc_id = aws_vpc.eks_vpc.id) with traffic_type = "ALL" and a destination CloudWatch Log Group or S3 bucket
